goal: Write a concise evidence-backed household hardware inventory at deploy/openwrt/household-inventory.md. Read repo fleet sources, setup-wireless.sh, node scripts and bd show mjolnir-mesh-rple for dated live evidence of the Symbio gateway pilot. Distinguish observed hardware from stale fleet entries and unknown capability. Include SKU/firmware/radio bands/known port roles/management paths, current three-node pilot topology, candidate upstream receiver constraints, a safe temporary Ethernet management topology, and next-hardware requirements. Never equate advertised driver combinations with qualified concurrent operation. This is a documentation-only inventory using existing evidence: no SSH, network joins, new scans, deployment or config mutation. Point future qualification to lpv and z3th; no duplicate markdown TODO list. Work within conductor-workers boundary: edit only declared path and return for conductor persistence. Do not expand into UX or runtime implementation.

anchors.invariant: Historical bootstrap inventory, not proof every listed node is currently present.
Retain observation date; do not relabel old snapshot live.
Radio roles are band-derived; mt76 concurrency assumptions need actual qualification.
Dated observed Symbio2.4GHz station on m3000-b,5GHz mesh to m3000/tr3000, actual verification and limitations.
One laptop WiFi radio; protect its internet default and preserve existing user edits.

acceptance.journey: An installer can identify a feasible upstream receiver and safe wired management arrangement from the inventory, with each observation dated and unknowns explicitly marked rather than inferred.
criteria: Pilot topology matches rple without claiming reboot qualification
Historical AP3000/WR3000S entries are distinct from observed pilot nodes
Ports and management paths cite concrete repo evidence or say unknown
Dual-radio and additional-radio/ethernet hardware limits are explicit

out_of_scope.item: Live qualification and production network profiles
